about: Option C crystal series (optc/PLAN.md). Frozen at gate G1 (18 Oct 2026). Species: Hill formula -> charge and role (acid / base as neutral partners). transfer: the D-H...A bond whose proton moves (rule in optc/src/cell.py). dpka = pKa(BH+) - pKa(HA), aqueous, 25 C, from the sources named; observed = state assigned by the depositing authors from heavy-atom distances (and H positions where located). 22 Oct 2026 (gap map B6): every dpka and dpka_range unchanged (dpKa fixed 18 Oct 2026, 11:05 PM IST; pcplut and nbaetpy added 20 Oct 2026); added fields only: dpka_alt / dpka_alt_range / dpka_alt_source (perchlorate), dpka_quality (dapsone and the 3,5-dinitrobenzoic acid crystals), dpka_off_axis / dpka_off_axis_reason (sulfamate), dpka_site / dpka_site_note (carboxy) and proton_evidence (method and H treatment from the CIFs) where it was missing.

cyano.proton_evidence: X-ray (MoKa), 298(2) K, CIF 2223527, _refine_ls_hydrogen_treatment constr: the transferring H1C (N1-H1C...O1) in a calculated position, riding (calc_flag calc, refinement flag R)

carboxy.proton_evidence: X-ray (MoKa), 293(2) K, CIF 2213511, _refine_ls_hydrogen_treatment constr: the transferring H1N (N-H1N...O1) in a calculated position, riding (calc_flag calc, refinement flag R)

sulfamate.name: 4-sulfamoylanilinium sulfamate
sulfamate.pka_note: sulfamic acid pKa about 0.99 (King & King 1952, doi:10.1021/ja01125a022); neutral reference is the O-protonated tautomer (outside the dpka analysis)
sulfamate.dpka_off_axis_reason: the sulfamic acid pKa (about 0.99, King & King 1952) is that of the zwitterion H3N+SO3- losing an N-H proton; the computed transfer puts the proton on O (the O-protonated tautomer H2N-SO2-OH, not measured), so dpka does not describe the computed neutral state (pka_note: outside the dpka analysis)
sulfamate.proton_evidence: X-ray (MoKa), 130(2) K, CIF 7230795, _refine_ls_hydrogen_treatment mixed: the transferring H41 (N4-H41...O21) from the difference map (calc_flag d; Uiso constrained, adp flag U)
